name: Arrested traveller, Montreal airport, Oct 2013 (silhouette only)
depiction: The 26-year-old woman arrested at Montreal-Trudeau airport around Halloween 2013 with three pumpkins that border officers say were hollowed out and filled with about 2 kg of cocaine. Charged at the time; drawn ONLY as a dark rim-lit silhouette (silhouette option): no face, no features; a plain coat. Never named on screen. Not a likeness. Tagged NOT A LIKENESS.
